site.tagline: Just a guy who loves coffee, jogging, and guitars

profile.name: Christian Corpez
profile.bio: Hey, I'm Chris as a 1st Year BS Agriculture Major in Agricultural Extension. And i believe life is best lived slowly — one cup of coffee at a time, one long jog at sunrise, one song on a quiet evening. This little corner of the internet is where I share who I am, what I love, and how to reach me.

hobbies.title: Jogging
hobbies.description: Morning runs clear my head. There's nothing like hitting the pavement at 5 AM while the city is still asleep.

hobbies.title: Coffee
hobbies.description: Black, pour-over, or espresso — I love them all. Coffee is less a drink and more a moment of stillness.

hobbies.title: Guitar
hobbies.description: Been playing since I was a teenager. Mostly indie, folk, and a bit of blues. It's my way of saying what words can't.

hobbies.title: Sleep
hobbies.description: Underrated superpower. 8 hours, no excuses. The best ideas come after a good night's rest.

contact.availability: Open to chats, collabs, and coffee meetups
